question: Can complete-truth unique-referent selection plus spatial ambiguity abstention retain query-span carrier recall on a third unconsumed HierText test cohort with no wrong carriers and no accepts for truth-absent queries?

source_contract.positive_authority: target is a legible printed word, occurs exactly once across every annotated word node in the image, and is not a substring of any longer annotated token
source_contract.negative_authority: first subsequent selected target under cyclic order that is not contained in any complete current-image truth token

selection_contract.order: official test annotation source order after excluding the first 60 images selected by the prior eligibility contract
selection_contract.per_image_target: largest normalized-area eligible complete-truth unique referent; lexical tie broken by normalized token
selection_contract.absent_query: first subsequent target in cyclic cohort order that is not contained in any complete normalized annotated word truth in the current image

algorithm_contract.baseline: single full-resolution frame, exact normalized target token, candidate confidence at least 0.45
algorithm_contract.successor: four-corner 1.5x multiscale observations plus exact query-span carrier projection and long-token edit-distance-one fallback from the prior protocol; when the best-rank observations form more than one spatial carrier component, abstain
algorithm_contract.query_span_projection: linearly interpolate both long edges of the OCR quadrilateral by normalized target start/end character offsets
algorithm_contract.ambiguity_abstention: connected-component clustering over best-rank projected/native boxes; more than one component returns UNKNOWN
algorithm_contract.candidate_binding: the sole-cluster accepted OCR box must cover at least half of the selected target truth bbox; otherwise WRONG_CARRIER
algorithm_contract.negative_acceptance: any accepted candidate for a complete-truth-absent query is a false accept

claim_boundary: A third fresh, disjoint 30-image cohort from previously unused HierText test pixels plus complete official word truth supports a static unique-text-referent OCR carrier Development result only. Complete-truth uniqueness removes text-identical instance ambiguity for this evaluator; it does not solve general open-world instance identity. Query-span projection and spatial abstention do not establish a facade, sign, portal, entrance ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment, or safety. UNKNOWN is neither negative nor known-safe. This cohort is consumed after the run; no conformal, FDR, or open-world guarantee is claimed.
